references.text: Joshua receives orders to set an ambush against Ai at night, a similar military strategy involving an ambush
Joshua positioned men in an ambush between Bethel and Ai, the same tactic of laying an ambush in the field
Israel laid an ambush around Gibeah, the same military strategy of setting up an ambush
Abimelech and his men lay in wait at night in four groups, a direct fulfillment of Zebul's advice
Saul set an ambush in the valley, similar use of an ambush as a military tactic
Joshua's men went out at night to lie in wait, the same element of a nighttime military maneuver
